worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.summary: Shoot an instant, travel-less psychic glare from your eyes: the psi line leaps between enemies, and every target it lands on takes Psychic damage and may be frozen. Because it is the mind that freezes, it can even freeze Ice types and abilities that are normally immune. If line of sight is cut, it does nothing.
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.use.0: Land an unavoidable hit on a kiting target in the open
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.use.1: Chain through a packed group and freeze several at once
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.use.2: Answer Ice types and immunity holders that should not be freezable
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.descript: Deals %1$s power to the first target, leaping to up to %2$s targets at x%3$s power per leap.
Sight range %1$s, leap distance %2$s; it needs an unobstructed line of sight.
Each target has a %1$s chance to be frozen; a %2$s immunity-ignoring window opens before the hit.
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.unblinki: Unblinking mode now: one more leap, longer range and a higher freeze chance, but a slower windup and cooldown.
Quick-glance mode now: fast and cheap, but it leaps to fewer and closer targets with a slightly lower freeze chance.
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.growth.0: From level %1$s the first-target power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.growth.1: From level %1$s first-target power %2$s and leaps %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.freezingglare.preferen: On: +1 leap, range x1.08 and freeze chance x1.2, but +2 windup and +6 cooldown. Off: quick glance, faster and cheaper, but range x0.95 and one fewer leap.
The companion only considers Freezing Glare while a target is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it close, larger locks on from further away.
When on, the companion prefers targets with others packed around them (the psi line leaps on); off considers a single target only.
When on, the companion prefers Ice types, whose freeze immunity this move pierces; off treats all targets alike.
world_combat.move.freezingglare.text.blo: The line of sight was blocked
